# Workspace Memory

This directory is for Task Ledger bridge docs and local working memory.

Commit the shared bridge docs in this directory. Do not commit personal journals. Put private notes in `journal-YYYY-MM-DD.md` or `<developer>/journal-YYYY-MM-DD.md`; they are ignored by default.

When a note becomes reusable team knowledge, promote it into `../specs/rules`, `../specs/guides`, `../specs/layers`, or `../specs/scenarios`.

Shared bridge docs:

- `task-index.md` - Task Ledger mirror/bootstrap checklist across goals, scenarios, layers, status, risk, and validation.
- `context-packs.md` - context-pack recipes for active work; Context Pack injection remains runtime-owned.
- `decisions.md` - decision mirror/review aid; durable task decisions belong in Task Ledger events.
- `risks.md` - risk mirror/review aid; blockers and review state belong in Task Ledger.
- `validation.md` - validation evidence mirror; completion truth belongs in Task Ledger plus observability/test evidence.
